notes.title: Dreadful Delivery Update v1.10
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

I'm excited to share the latest updates to Dreadful Delivery, featuring fixes, gameplay adjustments, and a significant milestone for accessibility. Thank you for your continued support and feedback—it helps to make the game better with every update!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Gameplay Adjustments:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to save your game progress between sessions.

[*] Enemy Aggression Levels have been fine-tuned to provide a more balanced experience. Each night now features a gradual increase in intensity, keeping the challenge engaging without being overwhelming.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where the night count remained stuck at Night 1. Nights will now progress correctly after each successful delivery.

[*] Fixed progression scaling to ensure that difficulty increases appropriately with each new night.
[/list]

[h1]New Language Support[/h1]
I am thrilled to announce that Dreadful Delivery now supports the following languages:

Japanese (日本語)
Korean (한국어)
Simplified Chinese (简体中文)
Russian (Русский)
French (Français)
German (Deutsch)
Portuguese - Brazil (Português - Brasil)
Spanish - Spain (Español - España)

You can select your preferred language via the Options Menu. Hopefully this makes the game more accessible and enjoyable for players around the world!

notes.title: Dreadful Delivery Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Dreadful Delivery Players!

First off, I want to extend a big thank you to all of you for playing and supporting Dreadful Delivery. Your feedback, enthusiasm, and support have been instrumental in shaping the game, and I truly appreciate your continued involvement in this journey.

There has been working a small patch that addresses some of the issues you may have encountered and introduces a few minor tweaks to improve your gameplay experience. Here’s a quick rundown of what’s new in this update!

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
Fixed a visual issue with the stalker facing the wrong direction.
Fixed an issue that resulted in the stalker becoming too passive.
Fixed an issue allow players to walk into the stalker.
Fixed an exploit that allowed players to deliver to the same house multiple times.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
Used a better explanation of how to use the 'spot' feature in the 'how to play section' section of the main menu.
Increased the volume for the successful use of the 'spot' feature
